summary: TonersCart admin v2 backend testing: 22/23 new tests pass (1 skipped — no shipped order exists for buyer1 to exercise buyer-side Confirm-Delivery email path). All admin v2 endpoints validated: GET /api/config/{key} returns spec-mandated defaults (4 popular_chips, 8 marquee_brands) without auth and without site_config table; GET /api/stats/public returns {suppliers,cities,brands} as ints, no 500 even with is_suspended column missing; GET /api/admin/analytics returns full payload (10-field stats block + orders_per_day with 30 buckets + commission_per_day with 30 buckets + top_models + top_dealers + orders_by_city) with admin Bearer; GET /api/admin/orders returns {rows,total,page,limit} with brand/model joined and commission/payout/commission_rate/supplier_name enriched per row; status filter works; GET /api/admin/orders/export returns Content-Type 'text/csv; charset=utf-8' starting with UTF-8 BOM (b'\xef\xbb\xbf'), Content-Disposition attachment, header row includes 'Order ID,Created,Status,Tracking,Buyer Name,...,Brand,Model,...,Commission,Payout'; POST /api/admin/suppliers/{id}/suspend + /unsuspend round-trip returned 200 OR 503 (verified observed code path — never 500); GET /api/admin/suppliers/{id}/detail returns {supplier,toner_listings,printer_listings,orders,stats{listing_count,order_count,gmv}}; DELETE /api/admin/listings/{nonexistent_uuid} and /api/admin/printers/{nonexistent_uuid} both return 200 (idempotent Supabase delete); POST /api/admin/config/popular_chips with admin returns 200 OR 503 (never 500), and when 200 the read-back via public GET reflects the write; PUT /api/orders/{id}/status invalid status returns 400; buyer cannot transition to shipped (403/400); /listings/search and /printers return 200 lists (graceful suspended filter). Unauth admin calls return 401/403 across all admin endpoints. Regression: tests/test_polish_patch.py (15/15), tests/test_batch_fixes.py (29/29), tests/test_supabase_backend.py (43/46 — 3 PRE-EXISTING failures already documented in iteration_6.json: auth/me supplier_status field mismatch ×2 + missing GOOGLE_API_KEY chat test). One stale assertion in test_supabase_backend.py was updated to match the new admin v2 spec: TestOrders::test_customer_cannot_change_to_delivered (which asserted buyer→delivered must 403) was renamed to test_customer_can_confirm_delivered_on_shipped and now asserts 200, because the spec explicitly says 'PUT /api/orders/{id}/status now supports buyer-side delivered on shipped orders'.

minor.issue: Cannot independently confirm whether response was 200 (migration ran) or 503 (column missing) — tests accept both per spec. Recommend logging the chosen code path on the server so operators can verify migration status from logs. Currently if the user runs supabase_schema_admin_v2.sql, these endpoints will silently switch from 503 to 200 with no visible indicator.

Does NOT verify the supplier exists before issuing the update. update(...).eq('id', sid) on a nonexistent UUID returns success with 0 rows affected. Caller cannot distinguish 'suspended successfully' from 'no such supplier'. Suggest returning 404 when count==0.

Same — DELETE on a nonexistent UUID returns 200 {ok:true}. Idempotent per Supabase, but the FE has no way to surface 'already deleted / not found' to the admin. Acceptable per spec but worth a UX note.

Test for the actual buyer Confirm-Delivery email side-effect (email_order_delivered_support) is SKIPPED because no shipped order exists for buyer1@test.com. Code path is reached & non-500 in code review, but Resend dispatch is not verified end-to-end. Action: seed at least one shipped order belonging to buyer1 to make this test executable.

Memory: builds the entire CSV in a StringIO buffer in-process. With 5000-row cap and current MVP volume this is fine, but switch to a streaming Response when row count grows. Also: tracking_number column is referenced via o.get('tracking_number') — when migration is pending, the orders SELECT '*,listings(...)' still works because '*' returns whatever columns exist, but the CSV will show empty Tracking column rather than 503. Working as intended per graceful-degrade spec.

Unknown keys (e.g., /api/config/some_random_unknown_key) silently return 200 with empty list rather than 404. May be a minor surprise for FE consumers — consider 404 for keys not in defaults AND not in DB. Currently spec-compliant for graceful degrade.

Sets allowed = {'requested','accepted','shipped','delivered','rejected','cancelled'}. Note 'requested' is checked but never set by /api/orders (which inserts 'pending'?). Worth auditing the canonical order-lifecycle state names — possible inconsistency between the create endpoint and this transition validator (out of scope of this patch).

Does not surface supplier_status for ex-applicants whose role reverts to 'customer' after rejection. Causes test_supabase_backend.py:198 + :595 (TestAdminApproval.test_reject_supplier, TestV2SupplierOnboarding.test_reject_v2_empty_with_reason) to assert 'rejected' but receive 'pending'. NOT from this patch.
Returns 500 'LLM key not configured (set GOOGLE_API_KEY in backend/.env)'. Only EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present. Unrelated to admin v2.

(Optional) Make DELETE /api/admin/listings/{id} and /api/admin/printers/{id} return 404 when row was not found, OR document that idempotent delete is intentional.
(Optional) Log a one-line server INFO when the suspend/site_config fallback (503 / no-tracking-column) is exercised so the user can confirm migration status post-hoc.

(REMINDER) Run /app/backend/supabase_schema_admin_v2.sql in Supabase. Once applied: suspend/unsuspend will return 200 instead of 503; tracking_number will persist; POST /api/admin/config/{key} will write the row; /listings/search + /printers will exclude is_suspended=true rows. Re-run tests/test_admin_v2.py — all 22 should still pass and the skipped one will need a seeded shipped order.

(File hygiene) server.py is 2161 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, listings, orders, admin_dealers, admin_analytics, admin_orders, admin_config, featured, quotation, public_stats, brochure, chat). Iteration 6 already flagged this.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from ~1631 → 2161 lines in this patch — file hygiene is now actively painful. Split admin endpoints into /app/backend/routers/admin_*.py modules before adding more.

GET /api/admin/analytics pulls up to 5000 orders + all suppliers + all users in three serial Supabase calls. As volume grows this will become slow and memory-heavy. Add an upstream 30-day filter on the orders query (server-side .gte('created_at', month_ago)) since only last-30-day buckets are used for the daily charts. Pre-aggregate in SQL (or a materialised view) once orders > ~10k.

GET /api/admin/orders does in-memory pagination after a 2000-row fetch. Should use Supabase .range(start, end) and a separate count='exact' call for total, otherwise page>1 always re-fetches the whole table.
GET /api/admin/orders/export builds the full CSV in RAM. Migrate to StreamingResponse with a generator before exporting on prod-scale data.

PUT /api/orders/{id}/status: when 'shipped' is set by the supplier WITHOUT tracking_number, the email_order_shipped side-effect is silently skipped (only fires when both shipped AND tracking_number). Decide whether shipping without a tracking number is a valid state — if not, validate at the endpoint; if yes, send a 'shipped (no tracking yet)' variant.

PUT /api/orders/{id}/status: try/except around update with 'tracking_number' inspects the exception string for the substring 'tracking_number' — fragile. If Supabase changes its error wording, the fallback breaks. Prefer probing the column once at startup or using a feature flag.

GET /api/admin/orders/export and GET /api/admin/orders: brand/model_number is pulled from listings via the !inner-like join (`*,listings(brand,model_number,...)`) — for orders whose listing was deleted, the join returns null and the order row will show '—'/'' in the CSV with no warning. Acceptable, but document for ops.

GET /api/stats/public uses .limit(2000) on listings & printer_listings just to count distinct brands. Replace with a server-side `select('brand').distinct()` or a small materialized view once catalog grows.

POST /api/admin/config/{key} accepts ANY shape via `value: Any`. There is no schema validation — an admin could overwrite popular_chips with a string and the frontend would crash. Add a per-key validator (pydantic discriminated union or simple isinstance checks for the two known keys).
GET /api/config/{key} returns 200 + empty list for any unknown key — easy for FE bugs to silently swallow typos. Tighten by returning 404 for keys not in the defaults map AND not in the DB.

Admin suspend/unsuspend currently does not also flip any cached 'public catalog' state — the next /listings/search call is the only place the filter takes effect. If you add CDN caching later, remember to invalidate.
_commission_breakdown is invoked per-order in analytics, orders list, and CSV export (3 distinct loops over the same data). Compute once per order at row-flatten time and reuse.
OrderStatusUpdate accepts tracking_number as Optional[str] but does not validate length/format — couriers expect 8-30 alphanumeric chars. Add a regex validator.
